asr.full_text: What is up everyone! Today I am going to show you the best simple number one way to navigate Binance, which is the biggest and most trusted exchange on the planet. Let's get right into today's conversation and look at how to sign up. First things first, click the link in the description or pinned comment right below this video. That'll take you straight to the Official Binance Registration Screen. Now a little pro tip for you. If you join through that specific link, you're going to unlock a 50% fee payback and a $600 rewards package instantly. It takes you literally 2 days to sign-up for the program, and it's basically FREE money just for getting started! Once you're on that page, let's create your account. Again use the link below the video to land on the signup page. You can choose to sign up with either your email or your mobile phone. Just enter the email you want to use, check that Terms and Conditions box at the bottom, and click Continue. In just a second, a six-digit verification code will be sent to the email or phone you provided. Grab that. Enter it in. Click CONTINUE. And then you'll be asked for a password. Make sure it's at least 8 characters long with ONE number and one uppercase letter to keep things secure. Boom! Your account is born. If that INVITER SCREEN pops up, just ensure the code is filled in and you're good to go. Next up, we have to handle the KYC identity verification. This is a must-do step because you need it to deposit, withdraw, or actually start trading. Since this involves a quick facial scan, it is way easier to just finish this part on your mobile phone, go ahead and install the Binance App and launch it. Log in with those new credentials, and you should be taken immediately to the verification screen. Confirm your nationality and click ID Type, whether it's a national ID, driver's license or passport. Honestly it all gets processed in about 5 minutes so choose whatever is closest to you right now. Select, Take Pictures as your method, and click continue. Take a clear photo of the front and back of your ID making sure it's readable and inside the frame. Next, just fit your face into that oval frame and follow the instructions on the screen. Once you're done with the scan, confirm your personal details and click Continue. Select your occupation, hit Continue, and finally pick your industry, and hit Continue again. The review takes about five minutes, and you'll see the verified status on your profile once it's all set. Now before we do anything else, let's lock down your security with 2 factor Authentication, or 2Fa. For this let's jump back to the PC screen. Under the Account menu click Security and then click Manage right next to the Authenticator app. When you hit Enable Authenticator App, Binance will send a verification code to your email or phone, just to be safe. Enter that, and a QR code will appear. Leave that there for a moment and download the Google Authenticator app on your phone. Open the app, tap Get Started, and I'd suggest clicking Use without signing in for extra privacy Hit Add a a code and then scan a QR code. Point your phone at the PC screen to scan that code and you ll see a 6 digit Binance OTP appear on your phone. Back on the computer, click Next. Enter those 6 digits from your app and hit Submit. Your Google OTP is now officially ACTIVE! And there you have it, you are officially verified and ready to start your crypto journey on the world biggest exchange! If this walkthrough cleared things up for you, you could do me a huge favor and smash that Like Button.
